categories.name: Cold kit
categories.who: Mornings near 40, the ridge near freezing

items.name: Fleece or puffer for all five
items.why: Layers, not one big coat. Mornings start at 40 and the car hits 70.

items.name: Hats and gloves, two pairs per kid
items.why: The first pair gets wet at Cataract Falls by 9:45.

items.name: Rain shells and a stroller rain cover
items.why: One day in three. Umbrellas don't work with a carrier.

items.name: Boots or closed shoes that can get muddy, all three kids
items.why: Cades Cove and the Grove are mud in November. Tubing requires secured shoes.

items.name: Wool socks, three pairs per person
Hand warmers, a dozen
items.why: Pockets at the top of Kuwohi and on the chairlift.

items.name: Soft structured carrier
items.why: SkyPark, the Skywalk, Kuwohi and Cataract Falls all ban or defeat strollers. Snejana lives in this.

items.name: Stroller with a bunting or blanket clips
items.why: Dollywood, Anakeesta, the aquarium, Sugarlands paved trail, Cable Mill.

items.name: Small daypack with the blowout kit and snacks
items.why: Lives in the car, goes on every walk.

items.name: Thermos, hot chocolate packets
Headlamps, two
items.why: It's dark at 5:25 and cabin driveways have no lights.

categories.name: Snejana
categories.who: 1 year old. The packing list is mostly hers

items.name: Pack-n-play + two fitted sheets
items.why: Confirm the cabin doesn't have one before you leave it.

items.name: Sound machine ×2
items.why: One for her, one for Slavik. Cabins creak and the heat pump cycles all night.

items.name: Black trash bags + painter's tape
items.why: Blackout for any room. Cabin porch lights are on all night.

items.name: Baby monitor
Fleece sleep sack, two
items.why: Cabin bedrooms get cold. No loose blankets.

items.name: Diapers: 8/day × days + 30 spare
items.why: Food City stocks them but you don't want that errand on night one.

items.name: Two packs wipes, diaper cream, changing pad, scented bags
Bottles or cups, milk plan, bottle brush, dish soap
Snacks and food for six days, bibs, spoons, two sippy cups
Portable high chair or clip-on seat
items.why: Check the cabin listing first.

items.name: Lovey, teethers, three books
Warm hat with chin strap and mittens that stay on
items.why: She counts as a heartbeat on the SkyLift. Hands get cold fast up there.

categories.name: Slavik
categories.who: 2, three in December. The flight risk

items.name: Diapers or pull-ups, plus travel potty if he's training
items.why: Keep the potty in the car. You'll need it on Little River Road.

items.name: Lovey and blanket
items.why: Pack it yourself. Don't let it ride loose.

items.name: Four extra outfits beyond your count
items.why: Mud, creek, snow at Ober.

items.name: Waterproof mittens and a hat he'll actually keep on
Familiar cup and plate
items.why: Meals go better with his own stuff.

items.name: Sticker books, chunky crayons, one new small toy held in reserve
items.why: For the Cades Cove loop.

items.name: Toddler harness or wrist leash
items.why: Decks, the Chondola platform, the SkyPark deck. This is the trip for it.

items.name: Measured height written on a card in your wallet
items.why: Dollywood 42 and 48, Ober tubing 42. Decides his whole week.

items.name: Waterproof gloves for tubing and the skating rink
Binoculars, cheap ones
items.why: Deer and turkeys in the Cove. His job. Bear spotting is everybody's job.

items.name: Headlamp
items.why: His job at the cabin after dark.

items.name: Small notebook
items.why: Count the deer, count the bears, write down the highest point in Tennessee.

items.name: Tablet, headphones, downloaded shows
items.why: Download before you leave. The park has no signal at all.

items.name: Uno, a deck of cards, one chapter book
Car seats installed and checked Saturday night
Blowout bag: full change of clothes for all three + two towels
items.why: Where you can grab it without unloading the trunk.

items.name: Puke bags, paper towels, a hanging trash bag
items.why: Little River Road and Newfound Gap Road are 50 miles of curves between them. Kids' Dramamine if anyone's prone.

items.name: Snack bin, cold water, spill-proof cups
Window shades ×2, small pillows and blankets
Car chargers, multi-port, one long cable
Offline maps for Sevier County and the park, cabin directions saved as a note
items.why: No signal from the Townsend Wye to Sugarlands and none on Kuwohi Road. Download the whole area.

items.name: Ice scraper, a blanket in the trunk, a half tank minimum going up the mountain
Park parking tag on the dash once you buy it Tuesday

categories.name: Medicine bag
categories.who: Assume you'll need two of these

items.name: Children's Tylenol and Motrin, infant and kid dosing
items.why: With the syringe. Write the doses on tape on the box.

items.name: Kids' antihistamine, hydrocortisone cream
Saline, nasal aspirator, humidifier if there's room
items.why: Cabin heat dries everyone out and the one-year-old gets the cold first.

items.name: Lip balm and a thick face cream for all three
items.why: Wind on the chairlift and the ridge chaps faces in an hour.

items.name: Tweezers, band-aids, antibiotic ointment, gauze
Thermometer, gas drops
Electrolyte packets or Pedialyte
Any prescriptions, plus a photo of each label
Insurance cards, pediatrician's number
items.why: Nearest ER is 30 minutes away in Sevierville. See the numbers.

items.name: Portable pressure baby gate, maybe two
items.why: Three stories of open stairs. Bring them even if the listing claims gates.

items.name: Ratchet strap or luggage lock for the hot tub cover
items.why: Cabin covers have clips that a two-year-old can open. Yours shouldn't.

items.name: Door alarms ×3
items.why: Every door onto a deck.

items.name: Outlet covers ×10, cabinet latches, corner guards
items.why: Cabin coffee tables are all sharp log corners.

items.name: Fireplace screen or a plan to not use it
items.why: Gas fireplaces have glass fronts that stay hot for an hour.

items.name: Two nightlights
Laundry pods, dryer sheets, extra trash bags
Coffee and filters, salt, pepper, olive oil, foil, a roasting pan
items.why: Cabin kitchens run bare and Thanksgiving dinner is on you.

items.name: Ziplocs, paper towels, dish soap
Power strip, extra phone chargers
Reusable water bottles, one per person
